exposure: Topical instillation of resveratrol (RV) preconditioned Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cell (WJ-MSC) secretome
outcome: Inflammatory cells in the ocular surface
cohort: Participants were an experimental model of severe dry eye disease induced by Concanavalin A.
finding: Topical instillation of RV preconditioned WJ-MSC secretome successfully improved tear film production and TBUT, promoted goblet cell restoration, reduced corneal fluorescein staining, and inhibited infiltration of inflammatory cells and secretion of VEGF.
